desc: Read N and P from stdin.
Precompute binomial coefficients C(n,m) mod P for n up to 435.
Precompute G_all[I][J] arrays for I,J in 0..k.
Implement DP recurrence to compute D[(I,J)] for all I=1..k, J=0..k using 1D convolution.
Run code on sample N=4 P=998244353 → expect "12 9 3 0".
Run code on sample N=10 P=433416647 → expect long output matching sample.
Debug and fix any discrepancies (e.g., convolution length, base cases, mod handling).
Optimize performance if too slow (e.g., skip zero entries, use local variables).
Ensure final output format: space-separated values for M = N-1 to N(N-1)/2.
